findings.label: Missing production build evidence
findings.detail: The on-disk .next directory lacks BUILD_ID, prerender-manifest.json, routes-manifest.json, and required-server-files.json, and .next/server/app has no prerendered page output. These are always emitted by a completed `next build`; what is present matches a `next dev` session. This contradicts plan.md's recorded 'npm run build succeeded' claim, so a completed production build cannot be confirmed. Per instructions the reviewer did not re-run the build. Resolution: the coder must run `npm install` then `npm run build` in c:\Users\Shaikh Nadim\OneDrive\Desktop\FK tiles work and leave the resulting production artifacts in place as verifiable evidence.

findings.label: Header 'Get Free Estimate' anchors to #contact instead of #estimator
findings.detail: Plan step 2 specifies the .btn-gold 'Get Free Estimate' action should link to #estimator. In components/sections/Header.js both the desktop and mobile instances use href="#contact". Both ids exist so nothing breaks, but the label promises the estimator and lands on the contact form. Repoint both instances to #estimator.
